notes: Account overview: Neutrino builds low-latency decisioning layer for derivatives pricing and trade routing.
Primary pain: inconsistent p95 latency spikes during market open; token costs scale unpredictably on current hosted provider.
They run two workloads: high-frequency reranking (tight p95 targets) and embedding-based candidate retrieval (hot prefix reuse).
Quote from CTO: "Need sub-50ms end-to-end p95 for rerank in US region or we lose flow to internal infra."
Current infra: hybrid — compute in GCP us-central, some models hosted with third-party API. Wants VPC + dedicated GPU pool for predictable throughput.
Interest areas: batching rules (dynamic batching at 6-12ms window), continuous KV/prefix caching for seen customers, 4-bit quantized variants for costable fallbacks.
Cost target: reduce per-request cost by 40% vs current provider; translate to ~ $0.0015-$0.0025 per token target when using optimized batching + quantized models.
Performance ask for POC: p50 < 12ms, p95 < 50ms for reranking payloads (max seq length 256), throughput target 2k RPS sustained during peak windows.
Compliance: SOC2 required; data residency EU for certain desks, KMS integration mandatory for key material used in Private deployment.
POC interest: Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput and Redwood Optimize recommendations (batch/caching/quantization) to hit cost/latency goals.
They requested a benchmark harness that exercises: small-chat-like prompts for rerank, prefix-heavy embedding lookups, and burst patterns (10x baseline) to validate autoscaling/burst capacity.
SE notes: plan to test 3 model variants in POC: baseline fp16 large model, int8 quantized medium model, 4-bit quantized tiny variant for fallback routing. Evaluate quality delta on held prompt set.
Legal: sent NDA + DPA 2025-09-20; legal asked for SOC2 attestation + encryption in transit + at rest details. Security FAQ link shared (drive doc above).
Sales notes: suggested 6-8 week POC: week1 infra prep & perf baseline, week2-3 Redwood Optimize tuning, week4 quality evals + canary to production on Dedicated pool.
Customer concern: fallback to smaller models must not flip signal ordering — want re-ranking rank-stability metric in bench (top-5 overlap >= 92%).
Pricing ask: reserved capacity quote vs metered hosted API — they lean reserved if we can guarantee latency SLOs and cost per token targets.
Meeting cadence: weekly syncs with AE/SE for duration of POC; invite includes trading infra + security leads; next sync scheduled after perf run.
Contact: CTO Aaron Millhouse, Head of ML Ops Priya Nair (priya@neutrinolatency.com).
